prj_supportdesk.description: AI-driven customer support triage desk with automated ticket sentiment tagging and instant chat resolution.

messages.content: I want to build an internal assistant chatbot

Great! Let's shape your internal assistant chatbot.

**Where should users interact with it?**
messages.thinking: Identify the primary interaction channel to scope the MVP.

metadata.question: Where should users interact with it?

messages.content:
Got it — an internal assistant chatbot for Slack / Microsoft Teams.

**What sources of knowledge should the assistant use?**
messages.thinking: Collecting the knowledge base choice to define the assistant's core data.

metadata.question: What knowledge sources should the assistant use?

messages.content:
Here's what I've understood:

**Product:** Internal Assistant Chatbot
**Target Users:** Employees (internal staff)
**Core Purpose:** Provide quick answers and assistance using internal knowledge bases.
**Interaction Channel:** Slack / Microsoft Teams
**Knowledge Sources:** Internal wiki / Confluence
**Persistence:** Store conversation history per user for context and analytics.
**Recommended Stack:** Next.js + TypeScript + TailwindCSS + Supabase
messages.thinking: Collected channel, purpose, and knowledge source; ready to generate build plan.

buildPlans.title: Internal Assistant Chatbot Build Plan
buildPlans.summary: Create a Next.js + TypeScript chatbot for employees that answers queries using internal wiki/Confluence data, stores per‑user conversation history in Supabase, and provides a responsive UI with TailwindCSS.

steps.title: Project scaffolding & architecture definition
steps.description: Initialize a Next.js TypeScript monorepo, add TailwindCSS, configure ESLint/Prettier, and set up Supabase client with environment variables. Draft high‑level component and data flow diagrams.

steps.title: Design Supabase database schema
steps.description: Create tables: users (id, email), conversations (id, user_id, created_at), messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, timestamp). Set up Row Level Security policies and generate migration SQL.

steps.title: Implement backend API routes
steps.description: Create Next.js API endpoints: POST /api/chat/message (store user message, call Confluence + LLM, store AI reply), GET /api/chat/history (fetch conversation history). Integrate with Confluence API (OAuth2) and LLM provider, handle errors and rate limiting.

steps.title: Build frontend chat interface
steps.description: Develop React components: ChatWindow, MessageBubble, MessageComposer, LoadingSpinner, ErrorBanner. Connect UI to API routes, manage conversation state with React Query, and persist user session via Supabase auth.

steps.title: Testing, CI/CD configuration & deployment
steps.description: Write unit and integration tests for API routes and UI components using Jest and React Testing Library. Configure GitHub Actions for linting, testing, and Supabase migration. Set up Vercel deployment with environment variables for Supabase and external APIs.

risks: Rate limits or latency from the wiki/Confluence API could degrade response times.
Improper handling of authentication tokens may expose internal data.
assumptions: A Supabase project is provisioned and API keys are available.
Confluence (or internal wiki) exposes a REST API with appropriate authentication.
An external LLM endpoint (e.g., OpenAI) is accessible for generating answers.

buildPlans.title: Add Supabase Authentication & Session Boundary
buildPlans.summary: Structure authentication architecture for SaaS SupportDesk AI, add sign-in form, session middleware, and user context injection into src/App.tsx.

steps.title: Define Authentication Architecture & Session Boundary
steps.description: Establish auth middleware, cookie parser, and token refresh configuration.

steps.title: Implement Sign-In & Registration UI
steps.description: Create responsive login dialog with email/password validation and error banners.

steps.title: Protect Application Routes & Inject User State
steps.description: Guard workspace routes against unauthenticated requests and expose user avatar in src/App.tsx.

steps.title: Validate Authentication Flow & Session Persistence
steps.description: Verify login, sign-out, session recovery across browser refreshes, and invalid credential handling.

risks: Existing unauthenticated route structure may require navigation guards.
Session hydration timing could cause temporary layout shifts if unhandled.
assumptions: Supabase project instance credentials will be configured.
User sessions will be managed via secure HTTP-only cookies.

I will structure the backend API endpoints for **HealthTrack Mobile Web** adhering to clean REST conventions.

### Backend Design:
1. **Endpoint Routing**: Create versioned handlers under `/api/*` with typed request schemas.
2. **Validation & Sanitization**: Reject malformed payloads early with explicit HTTP error responses.
3. **Service Layer**: Decouple business logic from route handlers in `src/api/routes.ts`.
4. **Telemetry & Logging**: Log execution duration and error stack traces to the activity stream.

I can structure these endpoints into an actionable build plan whenever you're ready.
